name: How long does a typical whole-home renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical whole-home renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timelines vary with size and complexity, but many whole-home renovations take 6–12 months of construction, plus several months of planning and permitting prior to starting work on site.
